verification.description: New accounts wait here until someone checks them against the DeMolay International member list. The automatic checks help; the decision is yours.
verification.emptyDescription: New signups appear here once they have confirmed their email and phone.
verification.drawerDescription: Check these details against the member list before deciding.

checks.title: Automatic checks
checks.ageOk: Aged {{age}}, which fits the member type.
checks.demIdFree: No other account uses this DeM ID.
checks.demIdInUse: This DeM ID already belongs to {{name}}.
checks.childNotFound: No member has this child's DeM ID.

approve.title: Approve {{name}}?
approve.description: The account opens and DeM ID {{demId}} is recorded. The member is notified.
approve.descriptionParent: The account opens and is linked to {{child}}. The parent is notified.
approve.needsChild: A parent can be approved once their child's DeM ID matches a member.

reject.title: Reject {{name}}?
reject.description: The account and the personal data entered are deleted. The reason is kept in the audit log.
reject.reasonHint: At least 5 characters. Recorded in the audit log.
reject.reasonTooShort: Give a reason of at least 5 characters.
